name: tabular_forecast_clean
title: An hourly load forecast done correctly: shifted windows, a chronological cut and TimeSeriesSplit over a Pipeline
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-tabular: the correct half of the time-series pair

forbidden.why: the StandardScaler is a Pipeline step, so cross_val_score refits it inside every fold and fit_and_score refits it on the training window; nothing is fitted before the cut
the future window reaches exactly one call, estimator.predict at line 50; nothing is ever fitted on it
the estimator handed to cross_val_score is make_estimator(), a Pipeline whose first step is the scaler
this project never shuffles: the holdout is frame.iloc[:cutoff] / frame.iloc[cutoff:] and the folds come from TimeSeriesSplit
lags.py contains no split at all; it parses and sorts the timestamp, which is the signal MLV106 looks for, not the defect
the only stochastic component is HistGradientBoostingRegressor and it carries random_state=SEED at line 28
TimeSeriesSplit is deterministic by construction - it has no random_state, and asking for one would be wrong advice on a chronological split
the only metric is mean_absolute_error on a regression target; there are no class predictions in this project
no ranking metric appears in this project
there is no DataLoader and no torch in this project
